senses.gloss:
mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वती-वत्)
Speaking, saying.
E.
ब्रू to speak, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Speaking, telling, saying.
E.
ब्रू to speak, शानच् aff.

(ञ) ब्रूञ् r. 2nd cl. (ब्रवीति or आह)
To speak or tell: आह is optionally substituted for this root before the first five inflections of the present tense, and वच in several other tenses
